subtitle: Lesson 21 · From training artifact to servable package

titlePlain: Pick a format by how far it

code:
apiVersion: serving.kserve.io/v1beta1
kind: InferenceService
metadata:
  name: fraud-detector
spec:
  predictor:
    model:
      modelFormat:
        name: sklearn
      storageUri: s3://ml-models/fraud-detector/3/
caption: storageUri points at the serialized artifact; modelFormat tells KServe which built-in server to launch.
Splitting model, config, and endpoint apart is what makes canary and blue-green rollouts possible later.
